summary: Project includes a leaderboard that needs correct time-based filtering (weekly/monthly) based on user-selected result dates.
architectural_notes: Use the user-selected result date to generate/store a timestamp used for leaderboard filtering windows (last 7 days / last 30 days).
known_issues: Leaderboard weekly/monthly filters are not currently filtering correctly.

existing_features.title: Ensure the frontend leaderboard filters (Weekly/Monthly/All Time) display rankings that match the corrected backend timeframe logic, without requiring changes to the user’s flow for selecting a date and recording/removing wins/losses.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement leaderboard time filters: weekly = last 7 days, monthly = last 30 days, using user-selected result date as timestamp; leaderboard should show only results within selected filter window.

Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so that:
- Weekly leaderboard shows only results from the last 7 days.
- Monthly leaderboard shows only results from the last 30 days.
- The date the user selected when recording a win/loss is the date used for timeframe inclusion.
- The returned leaderboard totals (wins/losses/totalGames/streak/score ordering) reflect only results inside the selected timeframe (not all-time totals).

Store and use a discrete timestamp derived from the user-selected result date when recording wins/losses so timeframe filtering is accurate.
- When a win/loss is recorded for a selected day, persist a timestamp representation for that result date that can be compared to 'now' to compute last-7-days/last-30-days windows.
- Ensure decrement/remove operations continue to work correctly with the new stored representation.
Add any necessary Motoko state migration for existing stored match results so existing daily logs continue to be readable and leaderboard queries do not trap after upgrade.

projectName: Fix leaderboard weekly/monthly time filtering using user-selected result date timestamps
